mentions.name: Yeast genotype-to-flavor converter
mentions.description: This project plans to purchase many characterized yeast strains, run them through an automated sequencing pipeline, and build a converter that maps yeast genotype to flavor profiles, with the eventual goal of genetically engineering custom yeast strains tailored to a person's favorite wine flavors.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm thinking about buying all the strains and pushing them through my automated sequencing pipeline, and building a yeast genotype -> flavor converter. Then, I think it'd be neat if you could have someone try a bunch of wines to get their favorite, and then genetically engineer a yeast strain specifically for their favorite flavors.
